message: Database 'legacy' (sqlserver) has no migration fact steps: its migrations keep TODO comments for this rename fact, and no ledger rows are written.

The change-type of column 'invoices.number' narrows the column (text to varchar(20)), so it also needs a data check: a query per dialect that finds the rows that would not fit, or accept with the reason no check is needed; or hold the fact.
The change-type of column 'invoices.number' needs a conversion: set conversion to { "cast": true } or give an expression per dialect, or hold the fact.
The drop of table 'old_notes' needs acknowledge: say why the data may go, or hold the fact.
The rename's from and to are the same ('total'): a rename changes the name or the schema.
The conversion has both forms: cast true and an expression; keep one.
The fact is released but not held: released lets a held fact run; set held too, or remove released.
The table key '01JENT00000000000000000006@01JDBS00000000000000000001' is listed twice.
A drop fact takes an object of kind column, sequence, table; this one is a view.
The after links of facts 01JFCT00000000000000000008, 01JFCT00000000000000000009 form a cycle, so no order applies them; remove one of the links.
The after links of facts 01JFCT00000000000000000008, 01JFCT00000000000000000009 form a cycle, so no order applies them; remove one of the links.

The fact follows '01JFCT00000000000000000099', which is not a migration fact of the model (folded or removed in another copy); the link is ignored for ordering. Remove it, or name the fact that replaced it.
The fact follows '01JFCT0000000000000000000G', a fact of another database; after links order the facts of one database. Remove the link.
This fact and fact 01JFCT0000000000000000000C both change column 'invoices.ref_code' and neither comes after the other (merged copies changed one object); order them with after, or fold them.
The value has no entry for postgresql (the dialect of database 'main') and no "*" entry, so a postgresql migration has nothing to run.
The raw fact needs a skipWhen guard: a query per dialect whose row means the end state already holds; or hold the fact.
This fact and fact 01JFCT00000000000000000002 both change column 'old_notes.body' and neither comes after the other (merged copies changed one object); order them with after, or fold them.
